en: A black‑and‑white aerial photograph of a small rural settlement surrounded by large cultivated fields and patches of forest. The village consists mainly of detached wooden or masonry houses with gabled roofs, a few small farm buildings and barns, and an emerging residential area where several new houses appear under construction. A main road runs diagonally through the scene, with smaller side roads and scattered homes. The landscape is gently rolling and heavily agricultural, with no high‑rise buildings or major monuments visible. There is no printed or handwritten text apparent on the front of the image.
